Company.title: Company
Company.description: Represents a single company within the multi-tenant ERP system, holding core configuration and identifying details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Company entity.

name.description: The legal name of the company.

streetAddress.description: The street address of the company's main office.

city.description: The city where the company's main office is located.

stateProvince.description: The state or province where the company's main office is located.

postalCode.description: The postal code of the company's main office.

country.description: The country where the company's main office is located.

phoneNumber.description: The primary contact phone number for the company.

emailAddress.description: The primary contact email address for the company.

logoUrl.description: URL to the company's logo image.

currencyCode.description: The ISO 4217 currency code used by the company (e.g., 'USD', 'BDT').

themeColorPrimary.description: The primary brand color of the company, in hex format (e.g., '#226FDB').

themeColorAccent.description: The accent brand color of the company, in hex format (e.g., '#2ED6F7').

isActive.description: Indicates if the company account is currently active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the company record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the company record was last updated.

subscriptionPlanId.description: Reference to the SubscriptionPlan currently active for this company. (Relationship: SubscriptionPlan 1:N Company)

Branch.title: Branch
Branch.description: Represents a specific branch or location of a company, enabling multi-branch architecture.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Branch entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the parent Company. (Relationship: Company 1:N Branch)

name.description: The name of the branch (e.g., 'Headquarters', 'Downtown Branch').

streetAddress.description: The street address of the branch.

city.description: The city where the branch is located.

stateProvince.description: The state or province where the branch is located.

postalCode.description: The postal code of the branch.

country.description: The country where the branch is located.

phoneNumber.description: The contact phone number for the branch.

emailAddress.description: The contact email address for the branch.

isActive.description: Indicates if the branch is currently active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the branch record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the branch record was last updated.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the ERP system. Assumes external authentication system for password management.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity (e.g., Firebase Auth UID).

companyId.description: Reference to the primary Company this user belongs to. (Relationship: Company 1:N User)

branchId.description: Reference to the primary Branch this user operates within. (Relationship: Branch 1:N User)

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user, used for login and notifications.

avatarUrl.description: URL to the user's profile avatar image.

languagePreference.description: The preferred language for the user interface (e.g., 'en' for English, 'bn' for Bangla).

dashboardLayoutConfig.description: JSON string storing the user's customized dashboard layout configuration.

sidebarMenuConfig.description: JSON string storing the user's customized sidebar menu configuration.

isActive.description: Indicates if the user account is currently active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: Defines a security role within the ERP system, dictating a set of permissions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Role entity.

description.description: A detailed description of the role's responsibilities and typical access level.

isSystemRole.description: Indicates if this is a pre-defined system role that cannot be deleted or extensively modified.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the role was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the role was last updated.

Permission.title: Permission
Permission.description: Represents a granular permission that can be assigned to roles.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Permission entity.

name.description: A unique, programmatic name for the permission (e.g., 'sales.invoice.create', 'product.view_own').

description.description: A human-readable description of what this permission allows.

moduleName.description: The name of the module this permission belongs to (e.g., 'Sales', 'Products & Services').

RolePermission.title: RolePermission
RolePermission.description: Junction entity linking Roles to Permissions, defining what actions a role can perform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RolePermission entity.

roleId.description: Reference to the Role. (Relationship: Role N:N Permission)

permissionId.description: Reference to the Permission. (Relationship: Role N:N Permission)

companyId.description: Optional reference to a Company, if the permission is granted specifically for this company. (Relationship: Company 1:N RolePermission)

branchId.description: Optional reference to a Branch, if the permission is granted specifically for this branch. (Relationship: Branch 1:N RolePermission)

UserRole.title: UserRole
UserRole.description: Junction entity assigning specific Roles to Users within a particular Company and Branch, enabling multi-company/multi-branch RBAC.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserRole entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User. (Relationship: User N:N Role)

roleId.description: Reference to the Role. (Relationship: User N:N Role)

companyId.description: Reference to the Company for which this role assignment is valid. (Relationship: Company 1:N UserRole)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch for which this role assignment is valid. (Relationship: Branch 1:N UserRole)

assignedAt.description: Timestamp when the role was assigned to the user.

SubscriptionPlan.title: SubscriptionPlan
SubscriptionPlan.description: Defines different subscription tiers available in the SaaS ERP system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SubscriptionPlan entity.

name.description: The name of the subscription plan (e.g., 'Free', 'Standard', 'Premium').

description.description: A description outlining the benefits and features of the plan.

priceMonthly.description: The monthly price of the subscription plan.

priceYearly.description: The yearly price of the subscription plan.

maxUsers.description: The maximum number of users allowed under this plan.

maxBranches.description: The maximum number of branches allowed under this plan.

features.description: A list of features included in this subscription plan.

moduleIds.description: References to Modules accessible with this plan. (Relationship: Module N:N SubscriptionPlan)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the subscription plan was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the subscription plan was last updated.

CompanySubscription.title: CompanySubscription
CompanySubscription.description: Tracks the active subscription details for each company.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CompanySubscription entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company subscribed. (Relationship: Company 1:N CompanySubscription)

subscriptionPlanId.description: Reference to the SubscriptionPlan. (Relationship: SubscriptionPlan 1:N CompanySubscription)

startDate.description: The date when the subscription became active.

endDate.description: The date when the subscription is set to expire.

status.description: The current status of the subscription (e.g., 'active', 'expired', 'canceled', 'trial').

lastPaymentDate.description: The date of the last successful payment.

nextBillingDate.description: The date for the next scheduled payment.

paymentGatewayTransactionId.description: The transaction ID from the payment gateway (e.g., Stripe, PayPal).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the subscription record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the subscription record was last updated.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Represents a customer of the company, involved in sales and service transactions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Customer entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company this customer belongs to. (Relationship: Company 1:N Customer)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch that manages this customer. (Relationship: Branch 1:N Customer)

userId.description: Optional reference to a User if the customer has a portal login. (Relationship: User 1:N Customer)

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

companyName.description: The name of the customer's company, if applicable.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

phoneNumber.description: The primary phone number of the customer.

streetAddress.description: The street address of the customer.

stateProvince.description: The state or province of the customer.

postalCode.description: The postal code of the customer.

totalDueAmount.description: The total outstanding amount due from this customer (calculated).

totalPaidAmount.description: The total amount paid by this customer (calculated).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the customer record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the customer record was last updated.

Supplier.title: Supplier
Supplier.description: Represents a supplier from whom the company purchases products or services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Supplier entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company this supplier provides to. (Relationship: Company 1:N Supplier)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch that manages purchasing from this supplier. (Relationship: Branch 1:N Supplier)

name.description: The legal name of the supplier company.

contactPersonName.description: The name of the primary contact person at the supplier.

email.description: The email address of the supplier's primary contact.

phoneNumber.description: The primary phone number for the supplier.

streetAddress.description: The street address of the supplier.

stateProvince.description: The state or province of the supplier.

postalCode.description: The postal code of the supplier.

totalDueAmount.description: The total outstanding amount due to this supplier (calculated).

totalPaidAmount.description: The total amount paid to this supplier (calculated).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the supplier record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the supplier record was last updated.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a physical product available for sale or used internally, with inventory tracking.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company that owns this product. (Relationship: Company 1:N Product)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch where this product is primarily stocked or managed. (Relationship: Branch 1:N Product)

description.description: A detailed description of the product.

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit, a unique identifier for the product within inventory.

unitPrice.description: The standard selling price per unit of the product.

costPrice.description: The cost price per unit of the product.

currentStock.description: The current quantity of this product in stock (calculated).

minStockLevel.description: The minimum stock level at which a low stock alert should be triggered.

warrantyInformation.description: Details regarding the product's warranty (e.g., '1 year manufacturer warranty').

countryOfOrigin.description: The country where the product was manufactured.

serialNumberTrackingRequired.description: Indicates if individual serial numbers must be tracked for this product.

isActive.description: Indicates if the product is currently active and available.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the product record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the product record was last updated.

ProductSerialNumber.title: ProductSerialNumber
ProductSerialNumber.description: Tracks individual serial numbers for products where serial number tracking is enabled.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProductSerialNumber entity.

productId.description: Reference to the Product this serial number belongs to. (Relationship: Product 1:N ProductSerialNumber)

serialNumber.description: The unique serial number of the product item.

status.description: The current status of the serial-tracked item (e.g., 'in_stock', 'sold', 'returned', 'in_repair').

companyId.description: Reference to the Company that owns this serial number. (Relationship: Company 1:N ProductSerialNumber)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch where this serial number is located. (Relationship: Branch 1:N ProductSerialNumber)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the serial number record was created/received.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the serial number record was last updated.

Service.title: Service
Service.description: Represents a service offered by the company, such as internet installation or CCTV maintenance.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Service entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company that offers this service. (Relationship: Company 1:N Service)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch that primarily offers this service. (Relationship: Branch 1:N Service)

name.description: The name of the service (e.g., 'Internet Installation', 'Monthly CCTV Maintenance').

description.description: A detailed description of the service.

price.description: The standard price for the service.

billingType.description: The type of billing for the service (e.g., 'hourly', 'monthly', 'fixed', 'one-time').

durationUnit.description: The unit of duration for the service, if applicable (e.g., 'hours', 'days', 'months').

durationValue.description: The numerical value for the duration, based on `durationUnit`.

isActive.description: Indicates if the service is currently active and offered.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the service record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the service record was last updated.

Quotation.title: Quotation
Quotation.description: Represents a sales quotation provided to a customer for products or services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Quotation entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company that issued the quotation. (Relationship: Company 1:N Quotation)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch that issued the quotation. (Relationship: Branch 1:N Quotation)

customerId.description: Reference to the Customer who received the quotation. (Relationship: Customer 1:N Quotation)

quotationNumber.description: A unique, sequential number for the quotation.

quotationDate.description: The date when the quotation was issued.

validUntilDate.description: The date until which the quotation is valid.

totalAmount.description: The total estimated amount of the quotation.

status.description: The current status of the quotation (e.g., 'draft', 'sent', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'converted').

notes.description: Any additional notes or terms for the quotation.

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the User who created this quotation. (Relationship: User 1:N Quotation)

convertedToSalesInvoiceId.description: Optional reference to the SalesInvoice if this quotation was converted into an invoice. (Relationship: SalesInvoice 1:1 Quotation)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the quotation record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the quotation record was last updated.

QuotationItem.title: QuotationItem
QuotationItem.description: Details for a single line item within a sales quotation, referencing a product or service.

id.description: Unique identifier for the QuotationItem entity.

quotationId.description: Reference to the parent Quotation. (Relationship: Quotation 1:N QuotationItem)

productId.description: Optional reference to the Product being quoted. (Relationship: Product 1:N QuotationItem)

serviceId.description: Optional reference to the Service being quoted. (Relationship: Service 1:N QuotationItem)

itemName.description: The name of the product or service quoted (denormalized for convenience).

quantity.description: The quantity of the item being quoted.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the item at the time of quotation.

totalPrice.description: The total price for this line item (quantity * unitPrice).

itemDescription.description: Specific description for this line item, if different from the product/service master.

SalesInvoice.title: SalesInvoice
SalesInvoice.description: Represents a sales invoice issued to a customer, detailing products/services sold and payment status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SalesInvoice entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company that issued the invoice. (Relationship: Company 1:N SalesInvoice)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch that issued the invoice. (Relationship: Branch 1:N SalesInvoice)

customerId.description: Reference to the Customer who received the invoice. (Relationship: Customer 1:N SalesInvoice)

invoiceNumber.description: A unique, sequential number for the sales invoice.

invoiceDate.description: The date when the invoice was issued.

dueDate.description: The date by which the invoice payment is due.

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the invoice, including taxes and discounts.

paidAmount.description: The total amount paid against this invoice so far (calculated).

dueAmount.description: The remaining amount due on this invoice (calculated: totalAmount - paidAmount).

status.description: The current payment status of the invoice (e.g., 'paid', 'due', 'partial', 'cancelled').

notes.description: Any additional notes or terms for the invoice.

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the User who created this sales invoice. (Relationship: User 1:N SalesInvoice)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the invoice record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the invoice record was last updated.

SalesInvoiceItem.title: SalesInvoiceItem
SalesInvoiceItem.description: Details for a single line item within a sales invoice, referencing a product or service.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SalesInvoiceItem entity.

salesInvoiceId.description: Reference to the parent SalesInvoice. (Relationship: SalesInvoice 1:N SalesInvoiceItem)

productId.description: Optional reference to the Product sold. (Relationship: Product 1:N SalesInvoiceItem)

serviceId.description: Optional reference to the Service rendered. (Relationship: Service 1:N SalesInvoiceItem)

itemName.description: The name of the product or service sold (denormalized).

quantity.description: The quantity of the item sold.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the item at the time of sale.

totalPrice.description: The total price for this line item (quantity * unitPrice).

serialNumberIds.description: References to ProductSerialNumber entities if individual serial numbers were sold. (Relationship: ProductSerialNumber N:N SalesInvoiceItem)

itemDescription.description: Specific description for this line item.

SalesReturn.title: SalesReturn
SalesReturn.description: Records products or services returned by a customer, linked to an original sales invoice.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SalesReturn entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company processing the return. (Relationship: Company 1:N SalesReturn)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch processing the return. (Relationship: Branch 1:N SalesReturn)

salesInvoiceId.description: Reference to the original SalesInvoice this return is linked to. (Relationship: SalesInvoice 1:N SalesReturn)

customerId.description: Reference to the Customer making the return. (Relationship: Customer 1:N SalesReturn)

returnDate.description: The date when the return was processed.

returnAmount.description: The total monetary amount credited or refunded for the return.

reason.description: The reason for the sales return.

status.description: The current status of the return (e.g., 'pending', 'completed', 'rejected').

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the User who initiated this sales return. (Relationship: User 1:N SalesReturn)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the sales return record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the sales return record was last updated.

SalesReturnItem.title: SalesReturnItem
SalesReturnItem.description: Details for a single item being returned in a sales return.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SalesReturnItem entity.

salesReturnId.description: Reference to the parent SalesReturn. (Relationship: SalesReturn 1:N SalesReturnItem)

productId.description: Optional reference to the Product being returned. (Relationship: Product 1:N SalesReturnItem)

serviceId.description: Optional reference to the Service being credited for return. (Relationship: Service 1:N SalesReturnItem)

itemName.description: The name of the product or service being returned (denormalized).

quantity.description: The quantity of the item being returned.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of the item at the time of sale/return.

totalPrice.description: The total price for this returned line item (quantity * unitPrice).

serialNumberIds.description: References to ProductSerialNumber entities for items returned with serial numbers. (Relationship: ProductSerialNumber N:N SalesReturnItem)

PurchaseOrder.title: PurchaseOrder
PurchaseOrder.description: Represents a purchase order issued to a supplier for products or services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PurchaseOrder entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company placing the order. (Relationship: Company 1:N PurchaseOrder)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch placing the order. (Relationship: Branch 1:N PurchaseOrder)

supplierId.description: Reference to the Supplier from whom the order is placed. (Relationship: Supplier 1:N PurchaseOrder)

orderNumber.description: A unique, sequential number for the purchase order.

orderDate.description: The date when the purchase order was issued.

deliveryDate.description: The expected date of delivery for the ordered items.

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the purchase order.

paidAmount.description: The total amount paid against this purchase order so far (calculated).

dueAmount.description: The remaining amount due on this purchase order (calculated: totalAmount - paidAmount).

status.description: The current status of the purchase order (e.g., 'pending', 'received', 'paid', 'partial', 'cancelled').

notes.description: Any additional notes or terms for the purchase order.

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the User who created this purchase order. (Relationship: User 1:N PurchaseOrder)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the purchase order record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the purchase order record was last updated.

PurchaseOrderItem.title: PurchaseOrderItem
PurchaseOrderItem.description: Details for a single line item within a purchase order, referencing a product.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PurchaseOrderItem entity.

purchaseOrderId.description: Reference to the parent PurchaseOrder. (Relationship: PurchaseOrder 1:N PurchaseOrderItem)

productId.description: Reference to the Product being purchased. (Relationship: Product 1:N PurchaseOrderItem)

itemName.description: The name of the product being purchased (denormalized).

quantity.description: The quantity of the item being purchased.

unitPrice.description: The agreed price per unit of the item.

totalPrice.description: The total price for this line item (quantity * unitPrice).

serialNumberIds.description: References to ProductSerialNumber entities received for items with serial numbers. (Relationship: ProductSerialNumber N:N PurchaseOrderItem)

itemDescription.description: Specific description for this line item.

PurchaseReturn.title: PurchaseReturn
PurchaseReturn.description: Records products returned to a supplier, linked to an original purchase order.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PurchaseReturn entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company processing the return. (Relationship: Company 1:N PurchaseReturn)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch processing the return. (Relationship: Branch 1:N PurchaseReturn)

purchaseOrderId.description: Reference to the original PurchaseOrder this return is linked to. (Relationship: PurchaseOrder 1:N PurchaseReturn)

supplierId.description: Reference to the Supplier to whom products are returned. (Relationship: Supplier 1:N PurchaseReturn)

returnDate.description: The date when the return to supplier was processed.

returnAmount.description: The total monetary amount expected as credit or refund for the return.

reason.description: The reason for the purchase return.

status.description: The current status of the return (e.g., 'pending', 'completed', 'rejected').

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the User who initiated this purchase return. (Relationship: User 1:N PurchaseReturn)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the purchase return record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the purchase return record was last updated.

PurchaseReturnItem.title: PurchaseReturnItem
PurchaseReturnItem.description: Details for a single item being returned in a purchase return.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PurchaseReturnItem entity.

purchaseReturnId.description: Reference to the parent PurchaseReturn. (Relationship: PurchaseReturn 1:N PurchaseReturnItem)

productId.description: Reference to the Product being returned to the supplier. (Relationship: Product 1:N PurchaseReturnItem)

itemName.description: The name of the product being returned (denormalized).

quantity.description: The quantity of the item being returned.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of the item at the time of purchase/return.

totalPrice.description: The total price for this returned line item (quantity * unitPrice).

serialNumberIds.description: References to ProductSerialNumber entities for items returned with serial numbers. (Relationship: ProductSerialNumber N:N PurchaseReturnItem)

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Records any incoming or outgoing monetary payment within the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Payment entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company involved in the payment. (Relationship: Company 1:N Payment)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch involved in the payment. (Relationship: Branch 1:N Payment)

paymentDate.description: The date and time when the payment was made or received.

amount.description: The monetary amount of the payment.

paymentMethod.description: The method of payment (e.g., 'Cash', 'Bank Transfer', 'Mobile Banking', 'Stripe', 'PayPal').

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the payment (e.g., transaction ID, check number).

paymentType.description: Indicates if the payment is 'incoming' (received) or 'outgoing' (made).

relatedEntityType.description: The type of entity this payment is related to (e.g., 'SalesInvoice', 'PurchaseOrder', 'Customer', 'Supplier').

relatedEntityId.description: Reference to the ID of the related entity (e.g., SalesInvoice ID, PurchaseOrder ID).

notes.description: Any additional notes regarding the payment.

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the User who recorded this payment. (Relationship: User 1:N Payment)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the payment record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the payment record was last updated.

Account.title: Account
Account.description: Represents a financial account (e.g., cash, bank, mobile banking) for tracking balances.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Account entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company this account belongs to. (Relationship: Company 1:N Account)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch this account is associated with. (Relationship: Branch 1:N Account)

name.description: The name of the account (e.g., 'Cash in Hand', 'Bank Account ABC', 'bKash Account').

accountType.description: The type of financial account (e.g., 'Cash', 'Bank', 'Mobile Banking').

currentBalance.description: The current balance of the account (calculated).

currencyCode.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the account's balance.

isActive.description: Indicates if the account is currently active for transactions.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the account record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the account record was last updated.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a general ledger transaction (income, expense, balance transfer) affecting accounts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Transaction entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company where this transaction occurred. (Relationship: Company 1:N Transaction)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch where this transaction occurred. (Relationship: Branch 1:N Transaction)

transactionDate.description: The date and time when the transaction took place.

amount.description: The monetary amount of the transaction.

description.description: A brief description or memo for the transaction.

accountId.description: Reference to the primary Account affected by this transaction (e.g., for income/expense, this is the account credited/debited). (Relationship: Account 1:N Transaction)

fromAccountId.description: Optional reference to the source Account for transfer transactions. (Relationship: Account 1:N Transaction)

toAccountId.description: Optional reference to the destination Account for transfer transactions. (Relationship: Account 1:N Transaction)

category.description: The category of the transaction (e.g., 'Sales Revenue', 'Office Supplies', 'Salaries').

relatedEntityType.description: The type of entity this transaction is related to (e.g., 'SalesInvoice', 'PurchaseOrder', 'Payment').

relatedEntityId.description: Reference to the ID of the related entity.

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the User who created this transaction. (Relationship: User 1:N Transaction)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction record was last updated.

Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: Stores detailed information about an employee of the company.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Employee entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company this employee works for. (Relationship: Company 1:N Employee)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch where the employee is primarily based. (Relationship: Branch 1:N Employee)

userId.description: Optional reference to a User if the employee has an ERP portal login. (Relationship: User 1:N Employee)

firstName.description: The first name of the employee.

lastName.description: The last name of the employee.

stateProvince.description: The employee's state or province of residence.

hireDate.description: The date when the employee was hired.

jobTitle.description: The official job title of the employee.

department.description: The department the employee belongs to.

salary.description: The employee's current gross monthly salary.

managerId.description: Optional reference to the Employee who is this employee's direct manager. (Relationship: Employee 1:N Employee - Self-referencing)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the employee record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the employee record was last updated.

Attendance.title: Attendance
Attendance.description: Records employee attendance for a specific day, including check-in and check-out times.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Attendance entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company where this attendance was recorded. (Relationship: Company 1:N Attendance)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch where this attendance was recorded. (Relationship: Branch 1:N Attendance)

employeeId.description: Reference to the Employee whose attendance is being recorded. (Relationship: Employee 1:N Attendance)

attendanceDate.description: The date for which the attendance is recorded.

checkInTime.description: The time when the employee checked in for the day.

checkOutTime.description: The time when the employee checked out for the day.

notes.description: Any additional notes regarding the attendance.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the attendance record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the attendance record was last updated.

LeaveRequest.title: LeaveRequest
LeaveRequest.description: Manages employee leave requests, including type, dates, and approval status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LeaveRequest entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company where the employee works. (Relationship: Company 1:N LeaveRequest)

branchId.description: Reference to the Branch where the employee works. (Relationship: Branch 1:N LeaveRequest)

employeeId.description: Reference to the Employee submitting the leave request. (Relationship: Employee 1:N LeaveRequest)

startDate.description: The start date of the requested leave.

endDate.description: The end date of the requested leave.

numberOfDays.description: The total number of days requested for leave (calculated).

reason.description: The reason provided by the employee for the leave request.

status.description: The current status of the leave request (e.g., 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'cancelled').

approvedByUserId.description: Optional reference to the User who approved or rejected the leave request. (Relationship: User 1:N LeaveRequest)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the leave request was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the leave request was last updated.

Payroll.title: Payroll
Payroll.description: Calculates and stores an employee's payroll details for a specific period.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Payroll entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company processing payroll. (Relationship: Company 1:N Payroll)

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for WarriorERP is designed with a strong emphasis on Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and consistent Access Modeling to support a multi-company, multi-branch SaaS architecture with robust role-based access control (RBAC). The core principle guiding this design is to enable simple, secure, and debuggable Firebase Security Rules without relying on expensive and complex `get()` calls to parent documents for authorization checks.

**Multi-Tenancy and Authorization Independence:**
1.  **Centralized Multi-Tenant Root:** The system uses `/companies/{companyId}` as the primary tenant identifier. This allows for clear segregation of all company-specific data. Every document related to a company or its operations directly or indirectly includes `companyId` as a top-level field or is nested under a `companyId` path.
2.  **Branch-Level Segmentation:** Further, most operational data is nested under `/companies/{companyId}/branches/{branchId}`, mirroring the multi-branch requirement. All documents within these branch-specific collections will have `companyId` and `branchId` as explicit fields, ensuring immediate authorization context within the document itself.
3.  **Denormalization for Item Entities (CRITICAL Mandate A):** For subcollections like `QuotationItem`, `SalesInvoiceItem`, etc., which inherently belong to a parent document (e.g., `SalesInvoice`), their schemas *do not* include `companyId` and `branchId` in the provided entity definitions. **To achieve Authorization Independence (Mandate A)**, these 'item' documents **must be extended to include `companyId` and `branchId` fields.** This allows security rules to evaluate access to an item directly, using its own `companyId` and `branchId` fields, rather than performing a `get()` operation on the parent `SalesInvoice` document. This is critical for robust security rules and efficient queries (QAPs).
4.  **User-Specific Denormalization:** The `User` entity itself is placed at `/companies/{companyId}/users/{userId}`, ensuring a user's primary profile is tied to a company. For individual user-owned data (e.g., `attendance`, `leave_requests`), these are further nested under `/companies/{companyId}/branches/{branchId}/employees/{employeeId}`. These documents also denormalize `companyId` and `branchId` (and `employeeId`) which is critical for employee portal access (e.g., an employee viewing their own payslip without needing to fetch their `Employee` document first in the rules context).

**Supporting QAPs (Queries Are Not Permissions Filters):**
1.  **Path-Based Scoping:** By structuring almost all data under `/companies/{companyId}/branches/{branchId}/...`, security rules can enforce that `list` and `get` operations are automatically scoped to the user's authorized `companyId` and `branchId`. A user can only query data within the `companyId` and `branchId` they are authorized for, minimizing accidental data exposure.
2.  **Explicit Authorization Fields:** Denormalizing `companyId`, `branchId`, `customerId`, `employeeId`, and `createdByUserId` into relevant documents allows for direct checks in security rules. For example, a customer portal can securely `list` their `SalesInvoice` documents by querying for `customerId == request.auth.uid` (assuming `Customer.userId == request.auth.uid`) while the rules simultaneously enforce `companyId == request.companyId` and `branchId == request.branchId` based on their session context.

**Role-Based Access Control (DBAC):**
1.  **Super Admin (Global Role):** A dedicated `/super_admins/{userId}` collection is used. The mere *existence* of a document with `request.auth.uid` in this collection grants a user superuser privileges, fulfilling the 'existence over content' mandate. This allows Super Admins to manage all companies, subscriptions, and system settings.
2.  **Company/Branch Specific Roles:** The `UserRole` entity, housed at `/companies/{companyId}/branches/{branchId}/user_roles/{userRoleId}`, explicitly maps a `userId` to a `roleId` within a specific company and branch. Security rules can efficiently `get()` this document (or a cached version in a request context if using backend rules) to determine a user's role and associated permissions (`role_permissions`) for the specific `companyId` and `branchId` of the data being accessed. This design ensures that role assignments are atomic and independently verifiable without complex parent lookups.
3.  **System Settings Segregation:** Global entities like `Role`, `Permission`, `RolePermission`, `SubscriptionPlan`, and `Module` are placed under `/system_settings`. This clearly separates immutable, system-wide configurations from dynamic, tenant-specific data, and restricts access to only Super Admins.

**Clarity and Predictability (Mandate D):**
*   Consistent naming (`companyId`, `branchId`, `userId`, `projectId`) and clear wildcards enhance readability and debuggability of rules.
*   The use of a single `status` field for state modeling is encouraged for clarity.

This structure prioritizes security and maintainability, ensuring that authorization logic is explicit, efficient, and aligned with Firestore best practices for multi-tenant applications.
